subject: CAIQ evidence packet: transport, preservation, and retention instructions
messages:
From: Cassandra Lee <cass.lee@ridgebank.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: RidgeBank Audit Team <auditops@ridgebank.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Request: CAIQ evidence packet + preservation instructions

Diego,

Thanks for taking our call yesterday. RidgeBank's external audit kicks off on 04/12 and we need the CAIQ response package along with clear instructions for how artifacts should be transported and preserved for sampling. Specifically the auditors asked for: 1) a consolidated CAIQ PDF with control mappings, 2) an inventory (CSV) of log/artifact locations, and 3) a retention/chain-of-custody matrix showing how long artifacts are kept and how they can be pulled for an audit window.

Can Redwood provide the packet and a one-page preservation guidance doc (we can accept a short spreadsheet) by EOD 04/05? Also confirm whether any of the artifacts will require a secured transfer (SFTP/secure Share) or if DocuSign/Drive links are acceptable.

Appreciate it — Cass

Cassandra Lee
Sr. IT Audit Manager | RidgeBank
cass.lee@ridgebank.com | +1 415-555-0198

Hi Cass — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can meet the 04/05 EOD target with a conservative packet and preservation instructions; full log harvest/delivery will follow as scheduled before the audit start. High-level plan below: 

- Deliverables by EOD 2027-04-05:
  - CAIQ_Response_Packet (single PDF) with per-control mapping to Redwood services and references to artifacts (not all artifacts embedded; links/manifest provided).
  - Evidence_Manifest.csv listing artifact path, owner, sampleability flag, retention period.
  - Retention_and_Chain_of_Custody.xlsx (1 sheet) describing custody flow, transfer mechanisms, and retention windows.

- Transfer method: For the initial packet we'll provide a password-protected PDF and the CSV/XLSX via a signed DocuSign envelope for chain-of-custody traceability. For large log exports we will provision a time-limited SFTP drop with audit logging (preferred for raw runtime logs). If RidgeBank prefers a secure Drive share, we can do that as long as the link is locked to a RidgeBank audit group and we provide a download manifest.

- Internal owners assigned (see CC):
  - Kimberly Park: control mapping & CAIQ narrative consolidation
  - Marissa Cole: artifact manifest & retention matrix
  - Diego Fernandez (me): transfer method, DocuSign envelope, and auditor liaison

I'll attach the first-pass packet and the retention matrix for your review. If the auditors require signed attestations for specific controls, we will add the attestation appendix and sign off.

Next steps: Kimberly will reach out if she needs additional evidence examples from your side. Marissa will confirm which runtime logs are in-scope for the 04/12 sample window.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com | +1 617-555-0134

Diego / Marissa — tagging in my notes after a quick pass of Diego's attachments. A few observations and asks for artifact collection: 

1) CAIQ_Packet_v1.pdf: good structured mapping. I'll add the per-control references (e.g., CCM/SC-7 -> network egress logs) and include example excerpts for encryption config. Expect an updated PDF by EOD 04/04 so you can review before we lock.

2) retention_matrix.xlsx: Marissa, can you confirm whether runtime KV cache snapshots are retained beyond 30 days in our default config? Auditors may ask for proof of non-persistence for ephemeral caches; if we can't produce a snapshot, we should add a short note in the manifest explaining retention policy and sampling limitations.

3) Transfer & Chain of Custody: I support using the DocuSign envelope for the initial packet (creates an audit trail). For raw log exports, SFTP with temporary credentials + syslog ingestion manifest is preferred. Diego, please prepare SFTP window details and estimated size so we can coordinate with RidgeBank's security team.

I'll carve out time at 15:00 PT to pair with Marissa on the manifest. Cass: if the RidgeBank team has any constraints on the SFTP IP allowlist, let us know before EOD.

All — quick update from the manifest side: I've confirmed the following retention points and will include short export proofs where available.

- Runtime logs (inference traces): retained 90 days by default; full exports available via SFTP.
- Platform audit logs (console & token events): retained 365 days in immutable store; we will include export manifest and hash checksums.
- KV caches / ephemeral state: not persisted beyond request scope; I will add an explicit note and a config snippet showing TTLs.
- Backups and snapshots: retained per customer (default 30 days for transient snapshots, 730 days for long-term backups where requested); I'll flag which artifacts are tenant-specific.

Diego — I'm attaching the evidence_manifest.csv (stub) and will finalize the retention matrix by EOD. After you send the DocuSign envelope I will populate the CSV with the signed timestamp and upload link.
